models.title: Models
models.subtitle: Manage your AI providers and monitor token usage.
models.description: Review provider setup, default model sources, and recent model usage trends in one place.
models.providersSubtitle: Configure API keys, default accounts, and available model sources.

local.sectionDescription: Configure the local model provider first, then add specific models. The default model is marked directly on the model entry.
local.providerConfiguredHint: The local model provider is configured. Use Configure in the upper-right corner to change the API key, Base URL, or protocol.
local.providerMissingHint: No local model provider is configured yet. Finish provider setup before adding models.
local.emptyWithoutProvider: Once you configure a local model provider, its models will appear here.
local.emptyWithoutModels: No local models have been added yet. After setup, add one model to get started.
local.remoteProvidersDescription: Manually manage cloud model sources and extra custom-compatible endpoints.
local.remoteProvidersEmpty: No additional model providers yet. Add OpenAI, OpenRouter, or a custom-compatible endpoint when needed.

setup.readyDescription: An available model has been detected. Continue to finish installation and enter chat.
setup.pendingDescription: Please add at least one available model. You can also return to Setup later and skip this step.

toasts.modelDeleted: Local model deleted. Syncing gateway configuration.
toasts.providerCleared: Local model provider configuration cleared. Syncing gateway configuration.

deleteDialog.title: Delete local model
deleteDialog.message: Deleting this model will immediately sync the gateway runtime model list. Sessions using this model will switch to an available model after the next refresh.

clearProviderDialog.title: Clear local model provider
clearProviderDialog.message: This will remove the linked local models and sync the gateway runtime configuration. Sessions using these models will no longer be available after the next refresh.

providerDialog.title: Configure local model provider
providerDialog.description: Enter the API key, Base URL, and API protocol. After saving, you can add models under this provider.
providerDialog.apiKeyPlaceholderEditing: Leave blank to keep the current API key

modelDialog.title: Add local model
modelDialog.description: Try loading the model list from the configured local model provider first. If the service does not support listing models, enter the model ID manually.
modelDialog.displayNamePlaceholderResolved: Default to the selected model name
modelDialog.displayNameHelpResolved: If left empty, the selected model name will be used.
modelDialog.manualModelHelp: This service did not return a model list. Enter the model ID manually.
modelDialog.displayNameHelpManual: If left empty, the model ID will be used as the display name.

models.loadingDescription: Syncing models and usage records. Please wait.

recentTokenHistory.title: Recent Token Usage
recentTokenHistory.description: Recent assistant responses and tool results with model/provider usage data.
recentTokenHistory.emptyForWindow: No token usage history in this time range
